result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban residential street with parallel parking on both sides and narrow sidewalks. There is a lack of dedicated pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, traffic calming, or pedestrian-scale lighting.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the narrow street obscures sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the street view

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, which may lead to unpredictable pedestrian movements across the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at potential crossing points to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or mid-block crossing points to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks to provide designated and predictable locations for pedestrians to cross.

result.summary: The image shows a mid-block urban residential environment with a wide, well-maintained sidewalk. A lane of parallel-parked cars provides a buffer between pedestrians and the roadway, although the streetscape lacks greenery and features several blank frontages.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The presence of a solid black fence and windowless lower building walls reduces natural surveillance and pedestrian engagement.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image and the lower level of the brick building.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting trees along the sidewalk would provide shade and a more pleasant, buffered environment for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Adding lighting specifically for the walkway would enhance safety and visibility during nighttime hours.

result.summary: The street provides continuous sidewalks on both sides, but lacks a buffer from the roadway and marked pedestrian crossings at the intersection. The absence of lane markings on a relatively wide street may lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning and higher speeds.

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: The intersection ahead lacks marked crosswalks, which reduces driver awareness of potential pedestrian crossings.

hazards.name: Lack of Lane Markings
hazards.description: The absence of a center line or lane markings on a wide street can lead to unpredictable vehicle paths.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface in the foreground and midground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions (bulb-outs) at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Roadway Striping
interventions.description: Add center line and edge line markings to narrow the perceived travel lane and organize traffic flow.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with modern multi-story townhomes and a paved sidewalk directly adjacent to the curb. The environment lacks a pedestrian buffer or street trees, and parked vehicles create significant visual obstructions between the walkway and the roadway.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: A silver car parked along the curb obstructs the line of sight between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, right side of the image

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is immediately adjacent to the travel lane with no physical separation or planting strip, increasing pedestrian exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk edge throughout the frame

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving vehicles.
